answer: Numbers first. Replication cost is posted per task: 3 replays, 2 signatures, 1 bond of 400 POA. Payment voids if the audit panel scores under 0.6 on the diversity index, and no identity may audit a recruit. Measured over 24 tasks: 22 cleared, 2 voided on panel overlap. A basalt-grade attacker needs 400 POA per identity plus 3 replays to earn one payout, so a haven of 1,000 accounts costs 400,000 POA before the first pigment of credit.
